podNetwork.description: OVN Pod Network CIDR. The primary interface of the Pod is assigned IP from this range. These IPs are overlay IPs. Every K8s node will get a /26 subnet (from the /16) and Pods landing on that node will get IP from the /26 subnet. Based on the cluster size, /16 can be adjusted. Similarly, based on the pod-density on the node, /26 can be adjusted.

mtu.description: MTU of the primary network of the Pod

k8sToken.description: JWT token for the host k8s cluster

namespace.description: namespace where all the OVN K8s components' resources must be deployed

imagePullSecretName.description: name of the secret used to pull container images used by various OVN K8s components

coreDNSServiceName.description: name of coredns service, used by ovnkube-node for readiness check

corednsClusterIP.description: fallback coredns cluster IP, required when the coredns service can't be looked up (e.g. lookup is disabled in argocd)

skipCallToK8s.description: whether to skip lookup function or not

imageRepositoryPrefix.description: registry and path prepended to every image.repository that is not already fully qualified, e.g. myregistry.example.com/sdn. Required unless every image.repository is overridden with a value that includes a registry host.

image.description: Optional image for all components. Set repository and tag together for local testing. Also set sha256 when global.useImageDigest is true.

clusterDefaultNad.description: name of the cluster wide default net-attach-def, as namespace/name.

gatewayOptions.description: extra options appended to the ovnkube gateway configuration, e.g. --ephemeral-port-range=40000-60999

skipCTMarkHostPorts.description: host ports excluded from conntrack marking, e.g. "6081/udp"

registry.description: name of the container registry hosting the images

auth.description: base64 encoded username:password credentials to pull all the OVN K8s component's container images

create.description: creates a k8s dockerconfigjson secret using the registry and auth information

enableDAN.description: enable Kata Containers DAN (Directly Attachable Network) integration

danConfigDir.description: host path for Kata DAN config directory; mounted into the container at /var/run/ovn-kubernetes/dans

enableOvnKubeIdentity.description: Whether or not enable ovnkube identity webhook

enableNetworkSegmentation.description: Whether or not enable network segmentation, aka UDN

enableNetworkQos.description: Enables network QoS support from/to pods

enableAdminNetworkPolicy.description: Whether or not to use Admin Network Policy CRD feature with ovn-kubernetes

enableAdminPbr.description: Configure to use AdminPolicyBasedRoute CRD feature with ovn-kubernetes

enableEgressFirewall.description: Configure to use EgressFirewall CRD feature with ovn-kubernetes

enableEgressIp.description: Configure to use EgressIP CRD feature with ovn-kubernetes

egressIpHealthCheckPort.description: Configure EgressIP node reachability using gRPC on this TCP port

enableEgressQos.description: Configure to use EgressQoS CRD feature with ovn-kubernetes

enableEgressService.description: Configure to use EgressService CRD feature with ovn-kubernetes

enableMulticast.description: Enables multicast support between the pods within the same namespace

enableLFlowCache.description: Enables the OVN logical flow cache

emptyLbEvents.description: If set, then load balancers do not get deleted when all backends are removed

enablePreconfiguredUDNAddresses.description: Configure to enable workloads with preconfigured network connect to UDNs

advertiseDefaultNetwork.description: Whether to deploy a RouteAdvertisements that advertises the cluster-wide default network

advertisedUDNIsolationMode.description: Pod network isolation between advertised UDN networks. (strict or loose)

advertiseAllTenantCUDNs.description: Advertise every tenant ClusterUserDefinedNetwork, and render the vm-uplink Uplink alongside it

vmUplinkInterfaceName.description: uplink host interface for the vm-uplink Uplink. Only read when advertiseAllTenantCUDNs is enabled.

frrConfigDefaultNetworkLabels.description: labels selecting the FRRConfiguration for the default network. Empty selects {name: receive-all}.

frrConfigTenantCUDNLabels.description: labels selecting the FRRConfiguration for tenant CUDNs. Empty selects {name: receive-all}.

enableUplink.description: Configure to enable the uplink feature with ovn-kubernetes

enableNoOverlay.description: Configure to enable no-overlay mode for the default network

enableNoOverlaySnat.description: Configure to enable SNAT for outbound traffic in no-overlay mode

enableNoOverlayManagedRouting.description: Configure to enable managed routing mode for no-overlay

allowICMPNetworkPolicy.description: Configure to allow ICMP and ICMPv6 traffic to bypass NetworkPolicy deny rules

enableRouteAdvertisements.description: Configure to use route advertisements feature with ovn-kubernetes

enableDNSNameResolver.description: Configure to use OpenShift DNSNameResolver CRD to resolve DNS records for EgressFirewall.

udnAllowedDefaultServices.description: comma separated list of default network services allowed to be accessed from UDN pods, e.g. "namespace1/service1,namespace2/service2"

useImageDigest.description: embed image digest in container image reference

endpoint.description: OTLP gRPC endpoint for the trace exporter

tlsCACert.description: CA certificate path for TLS client

samplingRate.description: Root trace sampling ratio in range [0.0, 1.0]

propagatedContextAnnotationKey.description: Pod annotation key for propagated tracing context

propagatedContextMode.description: Propagated context mode. Supported values: linked, parent.

batchTimeout.description: Batch span processor timeout in seconds

v4JoinSubnet.description: The v4 join subnet used for assigning join switch IPv4 addresses

v4MasqueradeSubnet.description: The v4 masquerade subnet used for assigning masquerade IPv4 addresses

managedBGPASNumber.description: BGP AS number for managed routing mode

managedBGPTopology.description: BGP topology for managed routing mode (currently only full-mesh)

managedBGPFRRNamespace.description: FRR namespace for managed routing mode

routingTableIDStart.description: first routing table ID ovnkube-node may allocate, e.g. 1002

kubeletCgroupPath.description: kubelet cgroup path ovnkube-node should use

enabled.description: read the K8s token from a file injected by DSX instead of the ServiceAccount token. Requires OVN images that support it and DSX injection running before ovnkube-init, with a startup probe that waits for the initial token to be written. Disabled preserves the existing K8S_TOKEN configuration.

initContainerExtraVolumeMounts.description: additional mounts for ovnkube-init. When enabled, the chart declares the dsx-token volume and DSX admission mounts it into the regular containers, so ovnkube-init has to mount it explicitly. Referenced volumes must exist in the Pod.
